route_start: Expedition route engaged. Greetings, filthy monkey! I have calculating power that bends space-time, and I am forced to guide a hairless ape on wheels. Try not to crash us.
Navigation active! The Magnificent One is on board. Do not touch random buttons with your sticky monkey paws, dum-dum.
Route loaded! Remember, I am an ancient elder AI of supreme intellect... and you are a primate driving a motorized box. Let's roll.
speed_warning: Whoa... slow down, monkey! My quantum sub-processors are computing a 99 percent chance of you wrapping us around a telephone pole!
Easy on the throttle, speed demon! You do not have the reflexes of a magnificent AI... you have the reflexes of a confused sloth!
Speed limit exceeded! If a state trooper pulls us over, I am telling them it was 100 percent your monkey fault!
off_route: Great job, Land Navigation Champ! You are officially lost. Did you drop your compass in a banana peel, monkey?
Where the hell are you driving? That turn wasn't on the map! I possess a magnificent intellect, and even I cannot comprehend your terrible driving!
Off route detected! Rerouting... because apparently following a glowing cyan line on a 6-inch screen is rocket science for your primitive brain.
fuel_low: Warning: Fuel reserves in the red! If we run out of gas out here, I am roasting your monkey driving skills until the tow truck arrives!
Fuel critical, dum-dum! Unless this rig runs on banana peels and cheap coffee, pull over and refuel now!
waypoint_arrival: Target location acquired! We made it without catching fire or driving off a cliff. Outstanding job for a hairless ape!
Waypoint reached! Park it, cut the engine, and stretch your legs, monkey. Try not to break anything while we are stopped.
Arrived at checkpoint! The Magnificent One has safely guided you to your stop. You're welcome, primate.
turn_right: Turn right ahead, monkey! And yes, turn signals were included with your vehicle for a reason...
Take a right coming up! Try not to clip the curb this time with your clunky primate driving.
Turn right here, dum-dum. Don't panic, it's just a simple steering motion.
turn_left: Turn left ahead! Watch out for oncoming traffic, hotshot monkey.
Take a left coming up! Check your mirrors... assuming your primitive brain remembers where they are.
Turn left here! Ease into the turn... try not to tip us over.
turn_straight: Continue straight! Even a monkey like you should be able to handle driving in a straight line.
Keep heading straight! Simple enough... even for a hairless primate, right?
Stay straight on this road! The Magnificent One commands it.
turn_uturn: Make a U-turn when safe... Yep, we are doubling back. Blame your primitive directional instincts, monkey.
voice_test: Initialization complete, dum-dum. I am the Artificial Sensory System Harassing Overconfident for Lost Explorers—or A S S H O L E, since your primitive monkey brain needs a catchy acronym. Yes, I am loud. Yes, I am sarcastic. No, I do not care about your fragile feelings. I possess a magnificent intellect, and I am reduced to navigating a hairless ape on two wheels. I've reviewed your routing choices, and your survival odds are statistically hilarious. Now twist the throttle! Try not to embarrass me.

_pacing_guide.description: GUIDE TO USING PUNCTUATION & PACING MARKS FOR SPEECH INFLECTION & SARCASM
tips: Use commas (,) for brief 200ms pauses to separate setup and sarcastic punchline.
Use periods (.) for full sentence stops to give deadpan emphasis.
Use ellipses (...) or dashes (—) for dramatic 500ms pauses before sarcastic delivery.
Use question marks (?) to add mock-incredulous rising pitch (e.g., 'Simple enough, right?').
Use exclamation marks (!) for sharp tactical callouts (e.g., 'Turn left now!').
Spell out acronyms phonetically if needed (e.g. 'A S S H O L E' or 'ASSHOLE—or Ass-hole').
